detail: User requests broader ablation + deeper exploration (mask, frequency, model design, loss, ratio, patch size). Current SOTA 4F.1 (clip=0.7319, lpips=0.3428) insufficient. 4G.2b revealed multi-step ODE invalidates per-step alpha. Direction selected: End-of-trajectory AdaIN (structural pivot) + Loss ratio grid + Patch size exploration. Priority 1: EOTA (directly addresses 4G.2b insight, structural not tactical). Priority 2: Loss ratio (user explicit). Priority 3: Patch size (user explicit).

Tried directions: dead_code, w_ll=0, extrap=0, adain=0, freq_mask, random_mask, DINO_block(NEG), lvl2/3/4, db2, LL_lock, per_subband_a1.0, per_subband_a0.5. New directions (EOTA, loss_ratio, patch_size) all differ from history.

Phase 4H.1: End-of-trajectory AdaIN. Add config endpoint_adain_only_last_step. Modify integrate_transport: when True, apply AdaIN only at i==steps-1 (last Euler step). Theory: decouple ODE solving (first N-1 steps) from style injection (last step). Restores alpha effectiveness. Test with per_subband mode (4G.2's clip SOTA + controlled lpips).

4H.1a (EOTA+per_subband+alpha=1.0) completed: clip=0.7359, lpips=0.3853. NEUTRAL: alpha=1.0 degenerates ((1-1.0)^n=0 for any n). 4H.1b (alpha=0.5) is DECISIVE: EOTA (0.5)^1=50% residual vs every-step (0.5)^8=0.39% residual.
